query:
ALTER TABLE plants
ADD COLUMN conservation_status ENUM(
  'extinct',
  'extinct_in_wild',
  'critically_endangered',
  'endangered',
  'vulnerable',
  'near_threatened',
  'least_concern',
  'data_deficient',
  'not_evaluated'
) DEFAULT 'not_evaluated' AFTER notes
